form.slugHint: Letters and numbers joined by hyphens, such as project-management.

errors.slug: Use letters and numbers joined by single hyphens.
errors.dateTime: Enter both a date and a time.
errors.https: Enter a link that starts with https://.

errors.publishText: To publish, fill in a title and a description in at least one language.
